notes.title: Quality of Life patch
notes.content:
[h3]Increased the player's chest capacity[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/2bd8eda3b37c95e8daf3c85b4e5980b5f095fcd1.png[/img]

[h3]Souls-like gamepad control redesign [/h3]
Now the right bumper is an attack, the left is a block. And running can be turned on with the left stick or X
Added hotkeys for fast movement and quick equipping of an item
Improved gamepad control in the inventory
Now you can switch between mouse and gamepad during the game (solo mode)
To switch from gamepad to mouse, left-click or Enter
To switch to gamepad, press A or Start

3 red scrolls + gold ring = Uber Scroll Fragment
3 Uberscroll Fragments + Endrian Stone of the Royal level = Uberscroll

Added the display of the key on the map of the location with mushrooms.
Improved loot in the location where Fakhim teaches you how to use stones.
Improved loot in the location where you are taught how to use scrolls.

notes.title: Pre-Beta
notes.content:
[h1]Three game modes[/h1]
Each mode has its own story progression.
The idea is that if you have completed one mode, you can start the next one with the same character, with the same equipment and level. You can also switch between them at any point  of  Story progression via the main menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/35d33df2de10e9d974929d43b5276d11bae6b73b.png[/img]

Saferis
Suitable for beginners and those who want to play relaxed
Penalty for death: none.
Bonus: none.

Evklidis
For experienced players. You have to make a choice whether to go further and risk the loot you have collected or return to restore your strength, stock up on potions and sell the loot. (My original idea that was in the early alphas)
Death penalty: lose 10% of your gold and all items from inventory.
Bonus: +10% EXP, +10% Gold. Item power slightly increased.

Keteris
Only for the chosen ones. In this mode, you can lose all your acquired gear and loot that you have collected. Also, the story progression will be reset. (Loot hidden in a player's chest does not disappear).
Death penalty: Lose 25% of your gold, all items in your inventory, and equipped items. Story progression will reset to the beginning.
Bonus: +20% EXP, +20% Gold. Item power increased.

[h3]The final area[/h3]
In the new area you can find new enemies, weapons, armor, roguelike dungeons and Mini boss White Lord.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/eb89f823de353dc39001a2fc35525d2b5f9b9337.png[/img]

Added 2 new scenes for the fight with simple enemies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/8de19bcb95ae00e41a6335d3d022f2b9bee9d166.png[/img]

In the new area you will find Gold Chests (3 Tier). They will drop golden rings and the Tarrland Hero Armor set (Both games share the same universe. Hero is a Unit from No King No Kingdom I ːKingSmileː)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/93f88dcbb57ddd7235bd9e1a56459980e4cc7d5f.png[/img]

[h3]Story[/h3]
Story progression and dialogues are 90% complete
Added the ability to talk to the skeleton from the dark library and even... I won't say more to avoid spoilers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/f194b649e604def774e151a16670bc197ff110f1.gif[/img]



[h2]Important changes:[/h2]

Damaging gloves!
Inserting a Endrian Stone ːTinyRubyː into the gloves gives a damage effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/9eac96d6d79ae63aabb3383db8c7ce40c3c27b99.png[/img]

[h2]Potion auto-replacement[/h2]
Now when you drink a potion, a new potion of the same type is taken from the inventory and equipped automatically.

[h3]Improved UI[/h3]
Added display of secondary equipment
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/88db5f3291d8509892ec1d4f89017847585a0897.png[/img]
Replaced equipment icons with more understandable ones
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/e5f86c556001aede50c34b96b08702705842573b.png[/img]

Improved tutorial
Books have been replaced with pop-ups.
Hidden 2 strong items in 2 starting locations

[h3]Minor changes and fixes:[/h3]
 
The amount of experience gained is now shown
Artifact drop chance increased
Rebalanced trio chest room
To level up you need more EXP now
Homunculus can be meet in dungeon.

Fixed Item stats popup for gamepads
Fixed bug Curse incorrectly affected trap strength
Enemies can now switch to other players
Fixed Item Pop-up in Split Screen mode
Fixed Book display in Split Screen mode

[h2]Extra[/h2]
[i]I originally wanted to release a Beta but decided to spend more time on stuff like Potion drinking mechanics, tutorial and other improvements. This is Pre Beta so the next major update will be a Beta where I will add the Final boss battle, NewGame+ and a few more things. 

Thanks to everyone who supported the gameːKingThumbsUpː.  During the next week, there will be an Event Chest in the cemetery with a new artifact.

[/i]

notes.title: Where is the progress?

I've been working on a big update that should bring Trapped Souls into beta.

notes.title: Map update
notes.content:
[i]I was able to take a big step forward in the direction of what I wanted Trapped Souls to be. The campaign map is now large and has a new content to explore. 
[/i]

[h3]Update v5[/h3]
The campaign map has been completely redesigned. Now explore the dungeons and complete various challenges to find keys and open doors. The map controller now follows the player, also added step sounds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/974b04a76b033b31af0b2a05198a49a574ee5686.gif[/img]
Mini dungeons and single rooms
Mini-dungeons are small dungeons in which you will have to roll a die to move, just like in the dungeons of the main bosses. At the end, you will mostly receive a reward or a special location such as Mushroom cave (best place to collect mushrooms)
Single rooms
Single rooms are locations from roguelike dungeons, although there are also unique ones such as Treasure room with 5 chest or battles with extra bosses. Most of these locations are one-time (in the future, it will be possible to play in New game+ and then it will be possible to go through them again)

-Red &Blue Lords
-Green Lord
-Purple Lord
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/2f53662c7326759ff9bcfc1fae95c646d10af9bc.png[/img]
New Bosses are very strong, maybe even stronger than campaign bosses, I advise you to prepare a good elemental defense to defeat them. As a reward for defeating them, you will receive Endrian Stones of the highest level

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[h2][i]
Over the past 3 months, I've reworked and polished most of the game, fixed critical bugs, replaced some textures, improved gameplay, improved sounds, and added a lot of new content.[/i][/h2]
[h2]Version 3 alpha:[/h2]

[h3]Dodge Roll[/h3]
The small jump has been replaced by a dodge roll.
The first couple of dodge-roll frames grant you invulnerability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/4f74d50cc3bbbc9c59c6de20abe7dd5bff7d1cbe.gif[/img]

[h3]Roguelike Relics[/h3]
During your dungeon runs, you will come across the Altar of Hope, which will give you a choice of one of three relics. Collected relics reset with each new run.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/c6993a8c21be45c221a165035c26d0c1a21bc248.png[/img]
[h3]Improved dungeon mode[/h3]
Added new challenges:
[list]
[*] Elite- Fight with powerful enemies
[*] Curse- With each curse, enemies become stronger and traps become more dangerous
[*] Altar of Hope- A safe place where you will be rewarded with a relic
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/a2dbda04bd9dcedd0420d9846c8e9c8328bf4db1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Second dice for dungeon mode[/h3]
Although I wanted to create a feeling of an unknown challenge, I also did not want everything to be pure randomness. That's why I added the second dice. Now you can choose between challenges. Sometimes it is beneficial to choose a smaller number so as not to miss something valuable or get into trouble.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/7dbcce57f723f6e99d8a1dec76a34e71de28f936.gif[/img]

[h3]UI[/h3]
UI usability was improved, inventory is now the first menu. The gamepad navigation has been significantly improved. When hovering over an item, its characteristics are displayed in popup. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/70f34d0288b46c518c0f18a450de9c57588d139e.png[/img]

[h3]Socketing now works through item combination[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/57f1f30b12230092d58df3eee079142f4f624b92.gif[/img]


[h3]Josephine in Dungeon[/h3]
Rarely during dungeon runs you can meet Josephine with a bunch of gold coins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27214676/8f0b12ce1be6021e3d2b0502b2214cd19d848d38.gif[/img]

[h3]Important changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bag items dont drop after death anymore!
[*] Strength, Dexterity and Willpower parameters have been removed, so you can equip any weapon and equipment
[*] New parameter-  "Load" has been added. The load increases the stamina cost of dodge roll
[*] Improved gamepad inventory management
[*] Socketing now works through combining
[*] Gozzo now also sells shields and magic staffs. Also, new expensive things such as broadsword and chain armor appeared for sale
[*] Potions have become more powerful
[*] The crafting slot can be used as an inventory slot
[*] 100% chance gold drop from mobs
[*] Gold gain rebalance
[*] Auto pick-up gold from mobs
[*] Blocking with a shield now turns on immediately after pressing the button
[*] When shield block is hit, less energy is lost
[*] Improved Tutorial
[*] Added unique rewards for defeating d boss bosses
[*] The amount of gold the player picked up is now displayed
[*] The item that the player picked up is now displayed
[*] Added volume settings to the main menu
[*] Added Jump buffer
[*] Add Damage dealt to enemy popup
[*] Improved sound design
[*] When pressing the left mouse button, you can now throw out the selected item
[*] Reworked loot drop table. Scrolls and armor drop from copper chests, weapons from elite opponents
[/list]

notes.title: Game development resumed!
notes.content:
[i]
[previewyoutube=zbPwQ9383JE;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, my name is Taras, also known as Fullmetal Developer. Trapped Souls(previously known as Heroes of Dark Dungeon ) has been on pause for quite some time. Now, I decided to recover the development of TS!  It's quite important for me to tell you why my game was on pause and why after so many years I decided to finish it.

I started developing this game when I was still a student in 2014. The first year went by quickly and was quite fun. Because during classes, I quietly developed my game on a laptop (my university had no relation to game dev). When the 2nd year of development was already underway, I decided to speed up and release the game into early access. I miscalculated the development and testing time. Therefore, even a day before the release, I was changing the game code and making corrections. Without enough testing, the game was released with critical bugs. That greatly affected sales. I fixed them and released updates with new content, the situation did not change.

In addition, steam also announced that it is closing Green light. I thought that maybe now I have the chance to make and release one more game before Green Light closes. So I decided to freeze the project and switch to a new one (No King No Kingdom). As the years went by, I was busy with new projects. Although I always wanted to return, but doubts held me back. And every year I was further and further away from it.

Recently, there was a massive missile attack on my city. It affected me and made me rethink many stuff. So, I decided that it was important for me to finish my first game, my own souls-like with loot like in D2 zy-el mod :)

Sorry for making you wait) But maybe this pause was for the best, now I have a lot more experience to make a great game.

The first big update is ready! Check out the Major Update

[/i]
